posts.title: Claude Code Talks Too Much, So I Moved the Noise to the Side
posts.description: Sideline is a Claude Code mod that does two things: it removes the noise from Claude’s conversation, and it moves the details I still care about (the files Claude changes, their diffs and the commands it runs) to a pane at its side. If you don’t want to read the whole post, these two commands install it: claude plugin marketplace add artberri/claude-plugins claude plugin install sideline@artberri

posts.title: Programming with AI, Without the Hype
posts.description: Is This Vibe Coding? Let’s start with the name. These days, every few months a new term appears to describe what is essentially the same thing: people using AI tools to write code. posts.title: How a Time Zone Change Could Break Your Apps
posts.description: Most people think of time zones as “offsets from UTC”, but we know they’re more than that: they also include rules, like when to switch to summer time, and the historical rules and offsets. If Europe removes the DST switch, Europe/Madrid would, for example, transition from a two-rule timezone (UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer) to a single offset.
